question: Which engine and component ABI baseline hosts first-vertical Essays extensions?
selected_option: Wasmtime Component Model host with a custom versioned Essays WIT world and a pinned WASI 0.2 toolchain baseline, exposing no WASI imports by default and selectively virtualizing only explicitly granted standard interfaces.
rationale: The user explicitly selected OPT-WASM-HOST-WASMTIME-COMPONENT-WASI02. It provides a typed portable component boundary on the more established WASI 0.2 toolchain while retaining deny-by-default control over every host import.

required_semantics: extensions are WebAssembly components whose imports and exports conform to an exact versioned Essays WIT world
the host and guest toolchains pin exact compatible Wasmtime, wit-bindgen, WIT dependency, WASI 0.2, and component artifact identities
WASI 0.2 is an interface and toolchain baseline, not an ambient capability grant
no WASI filesystem, sockets, HTTP, environment, arguments, standard I/O, clocks, randomness, or process-like interface is linked unless an explicit selected capability profile requires it
selected standard interfaces are virtualized by the host and narrowed to the invocation capability envelope rather than delegated to ambient host resources
component validation, interface compatibility, import closure, component digest, and policy checks complete before instantiation
Wasmtime stores enforce explicit memory, table, instance, transferred-data, execution, concurrency, output, and deadline limits
deterministic fuel provides the semantic execution budget while a wall-time watchdog supplies defense-in-depth cancellation
all guest outputs are treated as untrusted typed proposals or evidence and are revalidated by the native Rust daemon
non_implications: selecting WASI 0.2 does not expose any WASI interface by default
selecting Wasmtime does not make guest code trusted or make the Wasm host an Essays semantic authority
this decision does not select exact crate versions, WIT bytes, capability profiles, numeric budgets, component signing, registries, caches, or distribution
this decision does not preclude a separately reviewed WASI 0.3 migration after toolchain and conformance evidence exists
this decision does not authorize implementation, dependency installation, component execution, browser effects, publication, release, or deployment

remaining_blockers: WebAssembly first-vertical capability profile and security-owner review
WebAssembly numeric resource budgets and cancellation thresholds
WebAssembly component identity, signing, provenance, cache, and evidence rules
Essays security-owner review of the remote authentication binding
remote capability authorization and grant semantics
Product Capability decision and dependent contracts
authored ontology closure and DomainSpec generation
deferred_decisions: WASI 0.3 migration is deferred to a separately evidenced compatibility and conformance decision.
